title: Inflammation and cytokine signaling
abstract_text: Interleukin-6 is associated with inflammatory response activation in several biomedical studies. Evidence suggests that IL-6 signaling may contribute to immune pathway regulation.

title: TP53 and DNA damage
abstract_text: TP53 is involved in DNA damage response and cell cycle regulation. Several studies describe TP53 as a key gene connected to genomic stability.

title: EGFR pathway evidence
abstract_text: EGFR activation has been linked to downstream signaling pathways involved in cell proliferation. Evidence sentences are required before interpreting this relation.
